metadata.title: Urban Portrait with Vertical Display Typography

retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast urban portrait featuring a central subject with extensive tattoos and vertically oriented, stylized display typography on the right margin.
excludeWhen: minimalist subjects without tattoos are requested

recipe.visualDefinition: A medium shot of a shirtless subject with intricate full-body tattoos, captured with direct, harsh flash against a plain white wall. The subject is looking down, creating a sense of candid intimacy. To the right, large-scale, vertically stacked typography creates a strong structural border.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject occupies the central and left two-thirds of the frame
Vertical text acts as a structural column on the right edge
Harsh shadow cast directly behind the subject on the white background
Warm skin tones and gold jewelry contrast against the sterile white environment
coreInvariants: Subject looking downward or away from the lens

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centered-left, cropped from the waist up, filling approximately 70% of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and hands at the bottom center, where the action is focused.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the subject's face, follows the tattoos down to the hands, then moves up the vertical text column on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Clean white space on the left and right margins, though the right is occupied by typography.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Neutral white background providing high contrast.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep blacks in the hair, tattoos, and typography.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm tan skin tones and metallic gold from jewelry.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast with low color saturation, focusing on texture and form.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to white, black, skin tones, and gold.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Extra-condensed slab serif or blocky display face
letterConstructionRules: Uniform stroke weight with slab-like terminals
Letters are rotated 90 degrees clockwise and stacked vertically
Tight letter spacing within the vertical stack
characterSpecificRedesigns: The letter 'C' and 'E' have squared-off, aggressive terminals
The 'O' is a tall, narrow rectangle with rounded corners
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A smaller, secondary sans-serif or slab-serif for artist credits placed horizontally near the main title.

avoid: Serif fonts with high stroke contrast
Horizontal placement for the main title

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary blocky, condensed foundation for vertical stacking.
Matches the aggressive, industrial feel of the display text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast portrait of a tattooed man with dreadlocks looking down, lit with a harsh direct flash against a white wall. Leave the right 20% of the frame empty for text.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add vertically stacked, 90-degree rotated uppercase slab-serif text in solid black along the right margin.

verificationChecks: Is the text rotated 90 degrees clockwise?
Is the lighting harsh with a visible drop shadow?
Are the tattoos detailed and covering the torso?
Is the background a clean, flat white?

mustRedesign: Exact facial features of the celebrity
postGenerationChecks: Check for vertical text alignment accuracy
Ensure no text overlaps the subject's face
Confirm high-resolution skin and tattoo detail
recipe.reuseFormula: Urban Portrait [Subject Description] + Harsh Flash + White Background + Vertical [Font Style] Typography on Right
